OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

params._anchors: The binary format RR entries for the root DS records.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.algo: The address of the algorithm contract.

params.digest: The address of the digest contract.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.currentTime: The Unix timestamp to validate the records at.

setAlgorithm(uint8,address).notice: Sets the contract address for a signature verification algorithm.         Callable only by the owner.

setAnchors(bytes).notice: Sets the root anchors.         Callable only by the owner.

setDigest(uint8,address).notice: Sets the contract address for a digest verification algorithm.         Callable only by the owner.

verifyRRSetAt((bytes,bytes)[],uint256).notice: Takes a chain of signed DNS records, verifies them, and returns the array of signed sets.         Reverts if the records do not form an unbroken chain of trust to the DNSSEC anchor records.
